mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months indicates strengthening demand, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances with positive HOUST growth, or HOUST growth does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE decrease does not correlate with increased corporate costs.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals increased supply-side activity, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points over the past month signals a loosening monetary policy, which increases liquidity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with increased liquidity.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% over the past month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals a strong demand environment with reduced labor market slack, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 1 month
regime_hint: strong demand with labor market tightening
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with a strong demand environment.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with consumer confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO).
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decrease does not correlate with economic weakness.
